introText:
The Astrolábio is the official directory for information, regulations, and policies of the Swan Hotéis network.
Inspired by the instrument that guided navigators by the stars — among them those of the Cygnus Constellation, which also gives rise to the name Swan, in reference to the Schwan family — it symbolizes precision, orientation, and trust.
Just as the astrolabe safely guided explorers, this digital directory offers the guest clear and organized navigation, connecting tradition, technology, and hospitality.

policies.title: Hotel Policies
policies.nonSmokingDesc: To ensure a comfortable stay for all our guests, smoking cigarettes or any derivatives inside the rooms is strictly prohibited. Failure to comply will result in a R$ 250.00 sanitization fee.
policies.linensDesc: Improper use of bed/bath linens, furniture, or utensils may incur additional charges. In case of excessive dirt or damage, a fee proportional to the severity will be charged, even if identified after check-out.
policies.lostKeyDesc: In case of a lost or misplaced key card, a R$ 10.00 replacement fee will be charged.
policies.minorsP1: According to the Brazilian Child and Adolescent Statute (Law 8.069/90, Art. 82), the accommodation of children or adolescents in a hotel or similar establishment is prohibited unless authorized or accompanied by both parents or a legal guardian, or holding a Juvenile Court authorization.
policies.minorsP2: At check-in, presenting the minor's original ID in the presence of parents or a notarized written authorization when accompanied by a duly identified guardian is mandatory to protect the child or adolescent.
policies.guestsP1: Registering companions at the front desk is mandatory for personal and guest safety, and the corresponding additional fee will apply. Registration is not required in social areas.
policies.petLi1: One pet per apartment is allowed.
policies.petLi2: Presenting the pet's up-to-date vaccination card at check-in is mandatory.
policies.petLi3: Room cleaning must be scheduled by the owner, and hotel linens cannot be used for the pet.
policies.petLi4: The owner is responsible for cleaning up pet waste and keeping the pet quiet, as well as for any material or physical damage caused by the animal to the apartment, third parties, or hotel premises.
policies.petLi5: Pets are not allowed to remain unattended in the apartment for long periods (more than 4 hours).
policies.petLi6: When in social areas, the pet must be on a leash, held, or in a suitable carrier. Pet stay is restricted to the apartment. Please keep your pet away from food, beverage, event, pool, and gym areas.
policies.petLi7: Room cleaning will not be performed while your pet is inside the apartment.
